description: SESE pane-route reconciliation graph entered only when the host route index disagrees with the project route owner. It classifies the pane claimants host-wide, resolves the owner binding, verifies that no other claim holds the pane, publishes this binding's own route at its own address only then, and returns one named outcome. One tmux pane owns exactly one route binding host-wide, so a claimant from another project is the owner of the pane and not a neighbour. The reconciler is a republisher and never evicts or repairs identity: while any other claim holds the pane it leaves the index untouched and records the skip, because the pane is released only by the owning project's route owner or by the owner's explicit approved identity operation. A registration or approved recovery is a separate writer path: it may produce a binding only after the D2-B project/app scope check, endpoint ownership proof, expected incumbent binding/generation fence, and, when the automatic anchor ladder refuses to choose, an explicit user-approved identity decision for the exact target. Pane existence, equal pane name, recency, liveness, and caller approval alone are not subject continuity or endpoint ownership proof. A cross-project claimant stays owned by its project until that project's own owner retires it; no reconciler or fresh registration may silently replace it. Approved replacement can retire only the exact approved incumbent through the existing Register/binding owner; it cannot fabricate actor_binding_id or act as a grant change. The reconciler reports the remaining lag as RECOVERY_RECONCILE_REQUIRED with the remedy. The outcome is the reconciler's own Result, not a persisted identity receipt; the D2-B outer operation record belongs to the identity gate and is queried through the context entry, not through this graph. Query is a pure identity_gate read of durable phases and never calls this reconciler to repair or publish a route.
